description: Keep the question you are reading under and the agent's last answer in view while you scroll a long thread. Click either one to jump back to it; the page's address and the back button stay as they were. A counter such as 7/23 shows which turn you are on, and a turn that is still running pulses. A Pinned turns submenu in the thread's actions menu switches the bar and each option on or off. It reads BB's timeline layout, which is not a documented interface, so a BB update may need a plugin update. Requires BB 0.48 or later.
